text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios isn't feeling very well. I 
decided to have her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So exhausted~. Gonna sleep for now~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"What is this place~!! It looks like the 
perfect festival spot, but nobody's here!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nn... Something's written here. "A world 
you can't escape unless you reach Fever"?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this that thing?! You know, like on 
Umatter, "The room you can't leave unless 
you do [blank]"!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...... Where is the exit...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's the young miss—! Running into you 
here, isn't that fate?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...It seems you are the only one here, so 
allow me to ask. Do you happen to know 
where the exit is?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I know how to get out! Looks like we 
can escape if we trigger Fever!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
This is no time for fooling around. Please 
answer seriously.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pien! Seriously, believe me! It's written 
right over there!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"You can't get out unless you catch 
fever!" For now, if we just dance, we 
should be able to get out!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That is a story rather hard to believe. 
...To verify the truth, would you mind 
giving us a demonstration of the dance?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But if I actually manage to go home... 
then the young lady will be left all 
alone!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm going home without you, 
Milady! I'm so worried I could cry!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So... dance with me, Milady! Let's go out 
there together, the two of us!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's fever☆ C'mooon, Ojou~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Is this all right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady...! Nailed it! You're totally 
getting into the groove~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaay! Fever!! Milady is the beeeest! I 
luvvv Milady~~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ngh-ah?! A dream...?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Dancing with Ojo is, like, the best thing 
ever~! I'm so crazy happy right nowww~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Daitaku Helios had a good dream. 
After waking up, she was remarkably 
energized!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Come on, Milady, hurry up and—whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaah~! Heading back all by myself is... 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: A-A dream, huh...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Milady made it back safe... 
Ugh, I'm so sorry for leaving you behind, 
Milady~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Daitaku Helios had a bad dream. 
She remained in poor shape...
